about: Added copies show before the server answers (contract/collection-2026-10-15.md § Shown at once). Each case: the items and binder copies held (key -> qty), a batch's ops, and what is shown while the call runs. Taking the adds back (a failed call) must give the starting state again. Item keys are card|finish|condition|lang; binder keys binder|card|finish|condition|lang. Ops leave finish nonfoil, condition NM, lang en when unset.

cases.name: a scan session adds to a held item and makes new ones
a scan into a binder shows the copies in the binder
removals and set quantities wait for the server
